text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-17582 - region=eu-west inference latency spike (alerts: tail latency > 2s, some 5xx)
pagerduty: Paging on-call: @oncall-sre
alice.nguyen: acked on PD, grabbing it. Any customer-facing incidents?
oncall-sre: ack
alice.nguyen: I see elevated 95/99 latency for embeddings and short-text routes, rate ~1.2k rps. Some 503s from dedicated pools.
jordan.lee: noticed autoscaler logs showing scale loops, could be kvcache pressure. Posting logs.
sabin: @alice.nguyen can you confirm which region? eu-west-1?
alice.nguyen: yes eu-west-1. impact: some customers seeing degraded throughput and a few 503s, no data loss. Support flagged 2 large customers.
emma.k: rolling a quick mitigation suggestion: disable prefix caching on dedicated-pool-3 to reduce eviction storms? Thoughts.
jordan.lee: i'd prefer throttling the burst queue for that pool first. Also seeing `evict_count` rising in logs.
alice.nguyen: don't scale to 0; i'm spinning up +2 replicas to the dedicated pool and enabling read-only fallback to hosted lane for standard tier.
incidentbot: Action recorded: alice.nguyen added replicas +2 to pool-dedicated-3 at 3001239905
alice.nguyen: mitigation step: increasing pool capacity +2, enabling fallback route for tier=standard to hosted-api. ETA ~2m.
sabin: customer comms: pinging support to inform affected customers and providing interim workaround.
jordan.lee: KV eviction logs: `evict_count: 4321` and a couple OOM kills. suggest soft limit on cache size and restart offending pod.
oncall-sre: taking ownership of pod restarts. i'll cycle the worst offenders one at a time.
alice.nguyen: status ping: capacity up, tail latency dropping to ~800ms. 503 rate down ~60%. continuing to monitor.
sabin: support updated customers (acct-A, acct-B) with ETA and mitigation steps; they acknowledged receipt.
emma.k: i set a fallback policy to route 10% traffic to hosted; will scale that back as latency improves.
jordan.lee: still seeing occasional 5xx (~1/min). might be related to kernel-level memory reclaim under heavy batching. i applied `--batch-window=20ms` on a test node.
alice.nguyen: good. if 5xx persists after restarts, we'll canary rollback the latest runtime build.
oncall-sre: restarted 3 pods sequentially, no more OOM progression. latency 95% ~350ms. 5xx -> 0 in last 10m.
incidentbot: PD auto-update: PD-17582 status changed to acknowledged by alice.nguyen at 3001239950
alice.nguyen: assigning ownership to oncall-sre for follow-up and postmortem. i'll add a runbook note and timeline.
oncall-sre: taking postmortem owner. will collate logs and timeline; tentative postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC.
sabin: impact note: two customers (acct-A, acct-B) experienced degraded API for ~12m, no data loss; support will offer credits.
alice.nguyen: closing active mitigation. monitoring for 30m then we'll close PD. thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
pagerduty: PD-17582 status: resolved (closed by alice.nguyen) at 3001240200
